camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceSubTopic --region cn-hangzhou --ProductKey hf7680000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Queries the list of topics to which a device has subscribed
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备已订阅的Topic列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-sub-topic --product-key hf7680000 --device-name device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceSubTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view the product information in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device that you want to query.

You can view the device information in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备的设备名称。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html查看设备的信息
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
